answer: Commit-reveal bond: each identity stakes 40 credits on a falcon-signed hash in the atlas, then shows its receipt. A reused receipt or unrevealed commitment burns the stake. A copied reveal sends a ripple through the atlas as auditors replay every hash and flag the ring. One fake costs 35 plus 40 locked, so 1,000 fakes cost 35,000 and lock 40,000 against a 40,000 pool: net loss. An honest agent files one receipt, pays 40 once, keeps its share.
